anne-sales: Starting POC with Franklin Bank today. They're assessing replacing VendorX. Need a short checklist: parity, pricing delta, security sign-offs.

tariq-se: Key asks: API compatibility for /v1/generate, exact stop-sequence behavior, same header expectations, and identical burst rate-limits.

frank-cust: We use a preprompt chain + custom stop token. Billing is tokens+requests. Please provide an up-front cost comparison for 120M tokens/mo.

lee-ml: We'll collect a prompt sample (500 short, 100 long) and run side-by-side outputs. We'll record token counts and top-1 output diffs.

anne-sales: Can we provision a sandbox with IP allowlist and SAML SSO? They need outbound allowlist and SCIM for their ops team.

infra-bot: sandbox-franklin created (us-west-2). IPs: 34.201.10.4, 34.201.10.5. Vault path: secret/elmbank/poc-kms.

pat-security: I'll own the security questionnaire. Main blockers: customer-managed keys (HSM), audit logs retention, breach notify window.

tariq-se: For mapping, we can offer a lightweight shim. Example header map: VendorX:Request-Id -> X-Client-Request-Id. Also we expose identical token-bucket burst (300rps) at ingress.

lee-ml: Tokenization mismatch note: VendorX tokenizer differs; expect minor token count deltas. We'll run equivalence tests and produce billing delta numbers.

frank-cust: Procurement acceptance: 1) 95% semantic parity on the prompt corpus; 2) p95 latency within 25% of current; 3) KMS+SSO validated; 4) documented cost delta.

anne-sales: Action items: tariq run cost sim + burst smoke; lee create diff report; pat finish questionnaire; I'll coordinate legal on breach SLA. Target decision in 10 business days.

infra-bot: task created: FRANK-POC-42 (owner: tariq-se)

frank-cust: We'll do a sync call Friday 9am PT to review early diffs.

lee-ml: I'll join and present example regressions and suggested prompt shims.

pat-security: I'll attend for questionnaire walk-through.

anne-sales: Thanks team — keep this thread for quick Qs; meeting notes to calendar invite.

frank-cust: Thanks everyone.
